name: Aircraft
subtitle: Experimental VTOL research
summary: An instrumented electric VTOL demonstrator exploring intake design, tilting propulsion, and the transition to forward flight.
overview: The aircraft project investigates a circular nose intake, a tilting front electric ducted fan, and rear thrust vectoring. The approximately 2 kg prototype is intended as a technology demonstrator for collecting data and refining the concept.
current_state: The project is at the concept and engineering-validation stage. Stable hover, flight transition, final dimensions, and larger-scale feasibility have not been demonstrated in the supplied handoff.
highlights: Explore front and rear electric propulsion integration and controlled tilt mechanisms.
Measure thrust, electrical power, temperatures, airflow, and mechanical behavior.
Use staged experiments to investigate hover, transition, and cruise before considering larger aircraft.
next_focus: Resolve the propulsion and mass budget, then instrument and test the intake and tilt mechanism. Larger-scale feasibility requires separate validation.
